title: Hallucination
content: An AI hallucination is generated content that is unsupported or false but is presented as if it were reliable.

meta.why: A fluent answer can still misstate your product’s capabilities, terms, or availability.
meta.example: An assistant describes a product integration that the vendor does not offer.
meta.check: Check the claim against an authoritative source, and preserve the prompt and response when investigating an error.
meta.limitation: An incorrect answer does not reveal its own cause. Outdated source material calls for a different investigation than a generation error does.
meta.sources: Google Cloud: generative AI glossary | https://docs.cloud.google.com/docs/ai-ml/generative-ai/glossary | Platform documentation
